topic: 环境话题与学术阅读定位
grammarFocus: 被动语态；因果表达；分词作定语的基础辨认。
title: The Recycled Library: A Small Town's Big Change
instructions: 阅读下面的文章，回答10个问题。文章是关于一个小镇图书馆的环保改造。题目包括单选、填空、判断正误（True/False/Not Given）。填空答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。所有题目均为模拟练习，不是官方考试。
passage:
A. In the small town of Greenfield, the public library was old and dark. The building was built in 1950, and little money was spent on it for many years. In 2022, a group of local people decided to change it. They wanted a library that was good for the environment and good for the community. The town council agreed, and the project was started. The council also provided some money, but most of the work was done by volunteers. The volunteers gave their time freely, and they learned new skills during the project.

B. The first step was to reduce waste. Old shelves and desks were not thrown away. Instead, they were repaired and painted. Broken chairs were fixed by volunteers. Books that were too old to use were given to a recycling company. The company turned them into paper again. In this way, about 80% of the old furniture was reused. Even the old wooden doors were kept and used as tables in the reading room. The volunteers also collected old newspapers and magazines, and these were used to make art for the children's corner.

C. The second step was to save energy. New windows were installed, so less heat escaped in winter. Solar panels were put on the roof, and they now produce about 30% of the library's electricity. The lights were changed to LED bulbs, which use less power. Because of these changes, the library's energy bill has fallen by 40%. The building is also kept cool in summer by a new ventilation system that uses less electricity than air conditioners. The ventilation system brings fresh air into the building and helps to keep the temperature comfortable.

D. Water was also important. A special system was built to collect rainwater from the roof. This water is used for the garden and for cleaning. The garden itself was planted with local flowers and small trees. These plants need less water than foreign plants. Volunteers take care of the garden, and they also teach children about plants and insects. The garden has become a small outdoor classroom where school classes can learn about nature. The children enjoy looking for insects and learning their names.

E. The changes did not only help the environment. They also brought people together. The library now has a small café, where local food is sold. A corner for children was created with soft chairs and colourful books. Since the reopening, the number of visitors has doubled. Many people say they feel more comfortable in the new space. The café is run by a local family, and the money it makes helps to pay for new books. The library also holds weekly events, such as story time for children and talks by local writers.

F. However, not everything was easy. The project cost more than expected. At first, some people complained about the noise and the mess. The work took six months longer than planned. But in the end, most people in Greenfield are happy with the result. The library has become a model for other towns. Last year, visitors from three neighbouring towns came to learn about the project. Some of them have already started similar projects in their own towns. The project team shared their plans and gave advice to the visitors.

G. The library director, Ms. Chen, says, “We didn't do anything special. We just used what we had and tried to think about the future.” The town now plans to build a small park next to the library, using the same ideas. The park will be opened next spring. It will include a playground made from recycled materials and a small pond for rainwater. Ms. Chen hopes the park will become another place where people can meet and learn. She also hopes that more towns will follow their example.

questions.prompt: What was the main aim of the local people in 2022?
options: To build a new library in another town
To make the library better for the environment and the community
To sell the old library building
To close the library for repairs
answers: To make the library better for the environment and the community
questions.explanation: 文章第一段明确说他们想要一个对环境好、对社区好的图书馆。
questions.evidence: They wanted a library that was good for the environment and good for the community.

questions.prompt: How was most of the old furniture dealt with?
options: It was sold to another library.
questions.explanation: 第二段说旧家具没有被扔掉，而是被修理和重新使用。
questions.evidence: Old shelves and desks were not thrown away. Instead, they were repaired and painted.

questions.prompt: What percentage of the library's electricity is now produced by solar panels? (Write a number and % sign, e.g., 30%)
questions.explanation: 第三段提到太阳能板现在产生图书馆约30%的电力。
questions.evidence: Solar panels were put on the roof, and they now produce about 30% of the library's electricity.

questions.prompt: What is the rainwater used for?
questions.explanation: 第四段说收集的雨水用于花园和清洁。
questions.evidence: This water is used for the garden and for cleaning.

questions.prompt: Which heading best describes paragraph E?
questions.explanation: E段主要讲改造后给社区带来的好处，如咖啡馆、儿童角、访客增多。
questions.evidence: The changes did not only help the environment. They also brought people together.

questions.prompt: True or False: The project was finished earlier than planned.
questions.explanation: 文章说工程比计划多花了六个月，所以不是提前完成。
questions.evidence: The work took six months longer than planned.

questions.explanation: 陈女士说他们没做什么特别的事，只是用了现有的东西。

questions.evidence: The park will be opened next spring.

questions.evidence: visitors from three neighbouring towns came to learn about the project.

questions.explanation: 第三段明确说能源账单下降了40%。

grammar.title: 被动语态与因果表达
grammar.explanation: 被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者，结构是 be + 过去分词。例如：The library was built in 1950. 因果表达常用 because, so, in this way 等词。分词作定语时，单个分词放在名词前，如 recycled paper；分词短语放在名词后，如 books given to the company。
grammar.example: Old shelves and desks were not thrown away. Instead, they were repaired and painted.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The old books ___ to the recycling company last week.
questions.explanation: 书是被给的，且时间是 last week，所以用一般过去时的被动语态 were given。
questions.evidence: Books that were too old to use were given to a recycling company.

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses a causal expression?
options: New windows were installed, so less heat escaped.
New windows were installed, but less heat escaped.
New windows were installed, or less heat escaped.
New windows were installed, although less heat escaped.
answers: New windows were installed, so less heat escaped.
questions.explanation: so 表示结果，这里安装新窗户导致热量流失减少，因果关系正确。
questions.evidence: New windows were installed, so less heat escaped in winter.

questions.prompt: Identify the participle used as an adjective in: 'recycled paper'.
questions.explanation: recycled 是过去分词，放在名词 paper 前作定语，表示“被回收的”。
questions.evidence: The company turned them into paper again.

options: The garden was planted with local flowers.
The garden planted with local flowers.
The garden was planting with local flowers.
The garden plants with local flowers.
answers: The garden was planted with local flowers.
questions.explanation: 花园是被种植的，所以用被动语态 was planted。
questions.evidence: The garden itself was planted with local flowers and small trees.
